model_scope: complete original FuXi graph with internal decoder layer29 Wq LoRA and station PV head

raw_fields.name: power_mw
raw_fields.meaning: measured historical active power, never prior model predictions

normalization: station-specific training-only weather means/stds; power divided by station capacity
training_missing_policy: reject invalid histories and targets; no imputation
runtime_missing_policy: at most 2 consecutive missing power points may be forward-filled from an earlier measurement inside the window; weather is never imputed
server_side_requirements: contemporaneous normalized full global weather input
